043/**
044 * Implement a Robot Program framework. The RobotBase class is intended to be subclassed to create a
045 * robot program. The user must implement {@link #startCompetition()}, which will be called once and
046 * is not expected to exit. The user must also implement {@link #endCompetition()}, which signals to
047 * the code in {@link #startCompetition()} that it should exit.
048 *
049 * <p>It is not recommended to subclass this class directly - instead subclass IterativeRobotBase or
050 * TimedRobot.
051 */
052public abstract class RobotBase implements AutoCloseable {
053  private static final String PROGRAM_START_TIME_TOPIC = "/Robot/ProgramStartTime";
054  private static final AtomicInteger s_nextWarningReporterId = new AtomicInteger();
055
056  /** The ID of the main Java thread. */
057  // This is usually 1, but it is best to make sure
058  private static long m_threadId = -1;
059
060  private final MultiSubscriber m_suball;
061  private final IntegerPublisher m_programStartTimePublisher;
062  private final Map<String, Alert> m_telemetryWarningAlerts = new HashMap<>();
063  private final Map<String, Alert> m_tunableWarningAlerts = new HashMap<>();
064  private final BiConsumer<String, String> m_telemetryWarningReporter =
065      this::reportTelemetryWarning;
066  private final Consumer<String> m_tunableWarningReporter = this::reportTunableWarning;
067  private final String m_warningAlertIdPrefix =
068      "warning" + s_nextWarningReporterId.getAndIncrement() + "_";
069  private final AtomicInteger m_nextWarningAlertId = new AtomicInteger();
070
071  private final int m_connListenerHandle;
072
073  private static void setupMathShared() {
074    MathSharedStore.setMathShared(
075        new MathShared() {
076          @Override
077          public void reportError(String error, StackTraceElement[] stackTrace) {
078            DriverStationErrors.reportError(error, stackTrace);
079          }
080
081          @Override
082          public double getTimestamp() {
083            return Timer.getTimestamp();
084          }
085        });
086  }
087
088  private void reportTelemetryWarning(String path, String msg) {
089    reportWarningAlert(
090        m_telemetryWarningAlerts,
091        "Telemetry",
092        path + '\n' + msg,
093        "Telemetry '" + path + "': warning: " + msg);
094  }
095
096  private void reportTunableWarning(String msg) {
097    reportWarningAlert(m_tunableWarningAlerts, "Tunables", msg, "Tunable warning: " + msg);
098  }
099
100  private void reportWarningAlert(
101      Map<String, Alert> alerts, String group, String key, String text) {
102    synchronized (alerts) {
103      Alert alert = alerts.get(key);
104      if (alert == null) {
105        alert =
106            new Alert(
107                group,
108                m_warningAlertIdPrefix + m_nextWarningAlertId.getAndIncrement(),
109                text,
110                Alert.Level.MEDIUM);
111        alerts.put(key, alert);
112      }
113
114      alert.setText(text);
115      alert.set(true);
116    }
117  }
118
119  private static void closeWarningAlerts(Map<String, Alert> alerts) {
120    synchronized (alerts) {
121      for (Alert alert : alerts.values()) {
122        alert.close();
123      }
124      alerts.clear();
125    }
126  }

128  @SuppressWarnings("rawtypes")
129  private static class TunableMeasure extends Tunable<Measure> implements Tunable.CustomTunable {
130    TunableMeasure(Measure initialValue, TunableConfig config) {
131      super(config);
132      m_unit = initialValue.unit();
133      m_baseUnit = m_unit.getBaseUnit();
134      m_value = initialValue;
135      m_magnitudeTunable =
136          new TunableDouble(config, true) {
137            @Override
138            public void set(double value) {
139              m_value = m_unit.ofBaseUnits(value);
140              markChanged();
141            }
142
143            @Override
144            public double get() {
145              return m_value.baseUnitMagnitude();
146            }
147          };
148    }
149
150    @Override
151    public void set(Measure value) {
152      if (!m_baseUnit.equivalent(value.unit().getBaseUnit())) {
153        throw new IllegalArgumentException(
154            "Measure unit " + value.unit() + " is not compatible with " + m_unit);
155      }
156      m_magnitudeTunable.set(value.baseUnitMagnitude());
157    }
158
159    @Override
160    public Measure get() {
161      return m_value;
162    }
163
164    @Override
165    public Measure mutate() {
166      m_magnitudeTunable.set(m_value.baseUnitMagnitude());
167      return m_value;
168    }
169
170    @Override
171    public TunableDouble getInnerTunable() {
172      return m_magnitudeTunable;
173    }
174
175    @Override
176    public boolean hasChanged() {
177      return m_magnitudeTunable.hasChanged();
178    }
179
180    @Override
181    public boolean supportsChangeNotification() {
182      return m_magnitudeTunable.supportsChangeNotification();
183    }
184
185    @Override
186    public void resetChanged() {
187      m_magnitudeTunable.resetChanged();
188    }
189
190    @Override
191    public Class<Measure> getTypeClass() {
192      return Measure.class;
193    }
194
195    private final Unit m_unit;
196    private final Unit m_baseUnit;
197    private Measure m_value;
198    private final TunableDouble m_magnitudeTunable;
199  }
200
201  /**
202   * Constructor for a generic robot program. User code can be placed in the constructor that runs
203   * before the Autonomous or Operator Control period starts. The constructor will run to completion
204   * before Autonomous is entered.
205   *
206   * <p>This must be used to ensure that the communications code starts. In the future it would be
207   * nice to put this code into its own task that loads on boot so ensure that it runs.
208   */
209  @SuppressWarnings("this-escape")
210  protected RobotBase() {
211    final NetworkTableInstance inst = NetworkTableInstance.getDefault();
212    m_threadId = Thread.currentThread().threadId();
213    setupMathShared();
214    // subscribe to "" to force persistent values to propagate to local
215    m_suball = new MultiSubscriber(inst, new String[] {""}, PubSubOption.DISABLE_SIGNAL);
216    if (!isSimulation()) {
217      inst.startServer("/home/systemcore/networktables.json", "", "robot");
218    } else {
219      inst.startServer("networktables.json", "", "robot");
220    }
221
222    // set up telemetry
223    TelemetryRegistry.setReportWarning(m_telemetryWarningReporter);
224    TelemetryRegistry.registerBackend("", new NetworkTablesTelemetryBackend(inst, "/Telemetry"));
225    TelemetryRegistry.registerTypeHandler(
226        Measure.class,
227        (table, name, value) -> {
228          UnitTelemetry.log(table, name, value);
229        });
230
231    // set up tunables
232    TunableRegistry.setReportWarning(m_tunableWarningReporter);
233    TunableRegistry.registerBackend("", new NetworkTablesTunableBackend(inst, "/Tunables"));
234    TunableRegistry.registerTypeHandler(
235        Measure.class,
236        (initialValue, config) -> {
237          if (config == null) {
238            config = new TunableConfig();
239          }
240          return new TunableMeasure(
241              initialValue,
242              config.withProperty(
243                  "unit", UnitTelemetry.getUnitMetadata(initialValue.unit().getBaseUnit())));
244        });
245
246    // wait for the NT server to actually start
247    try {
248      int count = 0;
249      while (inst.getNetworkMode().contains(NetworkTableInstance.NetworkMode.STARTING)) {
250        Thread.sleep(10);
251        count++;
252        if (count > 100) {
253          throw new InterruptedException();
254        }
255      }
256    } catch (InterruptedException ex) {
257      System.err.println("timed out while waiting for NT server to start");
258    }
259
260    m_programStartTimePublisher = inst.getIntegerTopic(PROGRAM_START_TIME_TOPIC).publish();
261    m_programStartTimePublisher.set(WPIUtilJNI.getProgramStartTime());
262
263    m_connListenerHandle =
264        inst.addConnectionListener(
265            false,
266            event -> {
267              if (event.is(NetworkTableEvent.Kind.CONNECTED)) {
268                UsageReporting.reportUsage("NT/" + event.connInfo.remoteId, "");
269              }
270            });
271  }
272
273  /**
274   * Returns the main thread ID.
275   *
276   * @return The main thread ID.
277   */
278  public static long getMainThreadId() {
279    return m_threadId;
280  }
281
282  @Override
283  @SuppressWarnings("PMD.CompareObjectsWithEquals")
284  public void close() {
285    if (TelemetryRegistry.getReportWarning() == m_telemetryWarningReporter) {
286      TelemetryRegistry.setReportWarning(null);
287    }
288    if (TunableRegistry.getReportWarning() == m_tunableWarningReporter) {
289      TunableRegistry.setReportWarning(null);
290    }
291    closeWarningAlerts(m_telemetryWarningAlerts);
292    closeWarningAlerts(m_tunableWarningAlerts);
293    m_suball.close();
294    m_programStartTimePublisher.close();
295    NetworkTableInstance.getDefault().removeListener(m_connListenerHandle);
296  }

424  /**
425   * Start the main robot code. This function will be called once and should not exit until
426   * signalled by {@link #endCompetition()}
427   */
428  public abstract void startCompetition();
429
430  /** Ends the main loop in {@link #startCompetition()}. */
431  public abstract void endCompetition();
432
433  private static final ReentrantLock m_runMutex = new ReentrantLock();
434  private static RobotBase m_robotCopy;
435  private static boolean m_suppressExitWarning;
436
437  /**
438   * Gets the Robot subclass name from a stack trace.
439   *
440   * @param elements The stack trace elements to walk.
441   * @return The Robot subclass name.
442   */
443  protected static String getRobotName(StackTraceElement[] elements) {
444    // Walk bottom to top to account for multiple layers of subclassing
445    for (int i = elements.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
446      StackTraceElement element = elements[i];
447      try {
448        // Skip our own class when walking
449        if (RobotBase.class.equals(Class.forName(element.getClassName()))) {
450          continue;
451        }
452        if (RobotBase.class.isAssignableFrom(Class.forName(element.getClassName()))) {
453          return element.getClassName();
454        }
455      } catch (ClassNotFoundException e) {
456        // Unreachable
457      }
458    }
459    return "Unknown";
460  }
461
462  /** Run the robot main loop. */
463  @SuppressWarnings("PMD.AvoidCatchingGenericException")
464  private static <T extends RobotBase> void runRobot(Supplier<T> robotConstructor) {
465    System.out.println("********** Robot program starting **********");
466
467    T robot;
468    try {
469      robot = robotConstructor.get();
470    } catch (Throwable throwable) {
471      Throwable cause = throwable.getCause();
472      if (cause != null) {
473        throwable = cause;
474      }
475      StackTraceElement[] elements = throwable.getStackTrace();
476      String robotName = getRobotName(elements);
477      DriverStationErrors.reportError(
478          "Unhandled exception instantiating robot " + robotName + " " + throwable, elements);
479      DriverStationErrors.reportError(
480          "The robot program quit unexpectedly."
481              + " This is usually due to a code error.\n"
482              + "  The above stacktrace can help determine where the error occurred.\n"
483              + "  See https://wpilib.org/stacktrace for more information.\n",
484          false);
485      DriverStationErrors.reportError("Could not instantiate robot " + robotName + "!", false);
486      DriverStationErrors.reportCrash("Could not instantiate robot " + robotName + "!", elements);
487      return;
488    }
489
490    m_runMutex.lock();
491    m_robotCopy = robot;
492    m_runMutex.unlock();
493
494    boolean errorOnExit = false;
495    try {
496      robot.startCompetition();
497    } catch (Throwable throwable) {
498      Throwable cause = throwable.getCause();
499      if (cause != null) {
500        throwable = cause;
501      }
502      DriverStationErrors.reportError(
503          "Unhandled exception: " + throwable, throwable.getStackTrace());
504      DriverStationErrors.reportCrash(
505          "Unhandled exception: " + throwable, throwable.getStackTrace());
506      errorOnExit = true;
507    } finally {
508      m_runMutex.lock();
509      boolean suppressExitWarning = m_suppressExitWarning;
510      m_runMutex.unlock();
511      if (!suppressExitWarning) {
512        // startCompetition never returns unless exception occurs....
513        DriverStationErrors.reportWarning(
514            "The robot program quit unexpectedly."
515                + " This is usually due to a code error.\n"
516                + "  The above stacktrace can help determine where the error occurred.\n"
517                + "  See https://wpilib.org/stacktrace for more information.",
518            false);
519        if (errorOnExit) {
520          DriverStationErrors.reportError(
521              "The startCompetition() method (or methods called by it) should have "
522                  + "handled the exception above.",
523              false);
524        } else {
525          DriverStationErrors.reportError(
526              "Unexpected return from startCompetition() method.", false);
527        }
528      }
529    }
530  }
531
532  /**
533   * Suppress the "The robot program quit unexpectedly." message.
534   *
535   * @param value True if exit warning should be suppressed.
536   */
537  public static void suppressExitWarning(boolean value) {
538    m_runMutex.lock();
539    m_suppressExitWarning = value;
540    m_runMutex.unlock();
541  }
542
543  /**
544   * Starting point for the applications.
545   *
546   * @param <T> Robot subclass.
547   * @param robotConstructor Robot constructor.
548   */
549  public static <T extends RobotBase> void startRobot(Supplier<T> robotConstructor) {
550    // Check that the MSVC runtime is valid.
551    WPIUtilJNI.checkMsvcRuntime();
552
553    if (!HAL.initialize()) {
554      throw new IllegalStateException("Failed to initialize. Terminating");
555    }
556    UsageReporting.setReportUsageImpl(HAL::reportUsage);
557
558    // Force refresh DS data
559    DriverStationBackend.refreshData();
560
561    UsageReporting.reportUsage("Language", "Java");
562    UsageReporting.reportUsage("WPILibVersion", WPILibVersion.Version);
563    HAL.publishWpilibVersion(WPILibVersion.Version + " (Java)");
564
565    if (HAL.hasMain()) {
566      Thread thread =
567          new Thread(
568              () -> {
569                runRobot(robotConstructor);
570                HAL.exitMain();
571              },
572              "robot main");
573      thread.setDaemon(true);
574      thread.start();
575      HAL.runMain();
576      suppressExitWarning(true);
577      m_runMutex.lock();
578      RobotBase robot = m_robotCopy;
579      m_runMutex.unlock();
580      if (robot != null) {
581        robot.endCompetition();
582      }
583      try {
584        thread.join(1000);
585      } catch (InterruptedException ex) {
586        Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
587      }
588    } else {
589      runRobot(robotConstructor);
590    }
591
592    // On RIO, this will just terminate rather than shutting down cleanly (it's a no-op in sim).
593    // It's not worth the risk of hanging on shutdown when we want the code to restart as quickly
594    // as possible.
595    HAL.terminate();
596
597    HAL.shutdown();
598
599    System.exit(0);
600  }
